Feumaidh Dan is Gran co-dhùnadh gu luath, cò às a thàinig na tha seo de bhoiteagan, no thèid an t-seirbheis ùr 'son tioramachadh aodaich aig Eilidh, à bith!

programme.title: Beathaichean a’ Bocadaich
programme.desc: Tha Sophie a’ coimhead tron phrosbaig sheunta aice airson faicinn ciamar a bhios beathaichean a’ bocadaich. Tha i ag ionnsachadh mar a bhios diofar bheathaichean a’ gluasad agus cuide ri a caraidean, tha i a’ cruthachadh dannsa. An-diugh, danns coltach ri damhan-allaidh agus muc-mhara! Sophie looks through her magic binoculars to find out how animals boogie. She learns how different animals dance and, along with her friends, creates a dance using animal movements. Join her and dance like a spider and a whale!

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Tha na Losgannan a’ gabhail turas dàna spùinneadaireach a shireadh ulaidhean. The Froglets explore Lilly's desk and then set sail on a daring pirate quest for treasure.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha na planntraisean 's na lusan aig Mamaidh ri cleòcadh san teas ach, gu fortanach, tha deagh bheachd aig Meanbh airson Mamaidh a chuideachadh len uisgeachadh. Mother’s plants and flowers are wilting in the heat but fortunately, Tiny has a brilliant idea to help Mother out with watering.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha tòrr a’ gabhail àite an-diugh is tha Meanbh is Beag a’ faighinn dìoghladh ’son bhith foighidneach is grad-smuainteach an-diugh. Much is happening today, and Tiny and Small are getting rewarded for their patience and quick thinking.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachd do chlann òga. Tha Ellen NicDhòmhnaill a’ leughadh Beathaichean na Hòro-gheallaidh. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh is a dhealbhachadh le Alex Wilmore, agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Morag Stiùbhart. Ellen MacDonald reads Beathaichean na Hòro-gheallaidh, written and illustrated by Alex Wilmore and translated into Gaelic by Morag Stewart.

programme.title: Clann Na Cruinne
programme.desc: Anns a’ phrògram ghoirid seo tha balach òg a’ leantainn a mhiann a bhith a’ faicinn ochd-chasach dha fhèin. Lean Aonghas agus a chuid dealas airson ionnsachadh, agus e an tòir creutairean mara de ghach seòrsa, beag is mòr, annasach is anabarrach. A luminous and poetic short documentary following Aonghas, a young boy who roams the seashore in search of sea creatures, great and small, weird and wonderful. But will his dream of discovering an octopus ever come true?

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Chan eil beathaichean ceadaicht’ san fharpais teaghlaich, ’s chan eil Sebastian toilichte oir ‘s e Belle a theaghlach. Feumar rèiseadh le Angelina, an àite Belle. Ach dè an rùn-dìomhair a th’ aig Angelina? Animals aren’t allowed to participate in the family contest and Sebastian isn’t happy, as Belle is his family. He has to race with Angelina, instead of Belle. But what is Angelina’s secret?

programme.title: Cuach na Cloinne 2026
programme.desc: Cuairt dheireannach farpais ball-coise 5-a-side a’ gabhail àite ann an Inbhir Nis le sgiobaidhean bho air feadh na dùthcha a’ strì airson Cuach na Cloinne a bhuannachadh. The national final of the 5-a-side football competition takes place in Inverness, with teams from across the country competing to win Cuach na Cloinne.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc: Latha trang eile aig Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche le Ciorstaidh an Loiliopop a’ lìbhrigeadh Là Sàbhailteachd Rathaid agus Danny an Janny trang le Là Sàbhailteachd Teine. Bidh na camarathan againne a’ leantainn a h-uile rud a thachras tron latha. A hectic day at Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche with Ciorstaidh overseeing Road Safety Day, while Danny is also busy with Fire Safety Day. Our cameras follow all the events of this important day in the school calendar.

programme.title: Eilean Mo Ghaoil (From Lewis with Love)
programme.desc: Tha dùbhlain mu choinneamh Peigi Ann agus Martainn agus iad a’ feuchainn ri banais a chuir air dòigh, se àm cur a th’ann air machair Bhràdhagair agus ann a Nis, tha cothrom ann na tractaran as prìseil a thoirt a-mach às a gharaids. Peigi Ann and Martin have a few challenges to overcome in planning their wedding, it’s planting season at Bragar machair, and the most prized tractors are on display in Ness.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Melvin Oosterhuis from the Netherlands is Joy’s guest in the studio, and Calum Maclean visits a place of worship in a magnificent building in Glasgow’s west end.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Port Steòrnabhaigh
programme.desc: Based in the main port in the Hebrides, we follow the beating hearts of Stornoway Harbour. In her shelter, there is a bustling community to be found. In this episode, we see the final preparations for the arrival of the first cruise ship at the Deep Water Terminal, and the town centre gets a facelift with some new additions. Stèidhte ann am prìomh port nan Eilean Siar, the sinne a’ leantainn cridhe Port Steòrnabhaigh. Na fasgadh, tha coimhearsnachd trang ri lorg. Anns a’ phrògram seo, tha an obair steidheachaidh mu dheireadh a’ tachairt leis a’ chiad chrùs aig a’ Chala Dhomhain air fàire, agus leasachadh air meadhan baile Steòrnabhaigh. Thig còmhla rinn ‘s sinn a’ leanntainn beatha ann am Port Steòrnabhaigh.

programme.title: Patagonia
programme.desc: Keith MacDonald returns to South America where he lived a decade ago. Tha Keith Dòmhnallach a’ tilleadh a dh’Ameiriga a Deas far an robh e a’ fuireach o chionn deich bliadhna.

programme.title: Rurachd (Foraging)
programme.desc: Mary Ann celebrates the rose and cherry - and how taste and aroma count as much as appearance in their petals and fruit.

programme.title: Dàna | Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: Tha am preasantair Coinneach MacFhraing agus an Stiùiriche Hamish MacLeòid ag innse a h-uile càil mun t-sreath de phrògraman ‘Dàna’. Tha am prògram sònraichte seo a’ coimhead air cùlaibh ghnothaichean air an turas dànachd Eòrpach aig Coinneach gu Nirribhidh agus dhan Spàinn. Presenter Coinneach MacFhraing and director Hamish MacLeod spill the tea on all things Dàna. This special episode peeks behind the scenes of Coinneach’s bold European adventures to Norway and Spain. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Luchd-Brathaidh Cogaidh | Spies of War
programme.desc: 10 an t-Iuchar 1943: Tha saighdearan a’ Chaidreibh a’ dol air tìr ann an Sicily, toiseach a’ chrìch dha ìmpireachd nan Nàsach. Dà mhìos ron sin, chaidh corp oifigear Breatannach a lorg air tràigh anns an Spàinn le pàipearan ag innse mu ionnsaigh air na dùthchannan Bàlcanach na chois. Tha na Gearmailtich a’ faighinn grèim air na pàipearan – ach chan eil ann ach cleas Breatannach. 10 July 1943: Allied troops land in Sicily, opening a breach in the Nazi empire. Two months earlier, a British officer’s body is found on a Spanish beach with documents revealing a Balkan invasion. The Germans seize them - but it’s a British ruse. Dubbed in Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Universe

programme.title: The Nazis: A Warning from History
programme.desc: A look at the extraordinary popularity of both Hitler and the Nazis, as well as the astonishing degree of voluntary support ordinary Germans gave the infamous Gestapo. Despite the popular mythology of Nazi efficiency, Dr Gunter Lohse, a former German Foreign Office official and member of the Nazi party, recalls that behind the scenes 'it was total chaos'.

programme.title: One Foot in Arthur's Seat
programme.desc: Actor Ian Richardson walks up the hill to Arthur's Seat, which overlooks the city of Edinburgh, as he did during lunch hours as a bored office clerk 50 years ago.

programme.title: Remembers...
programme.desc: As part of Pride Month, W Stephen Gilbert looks back on the BBC drama Only Connect that he commissioned and produced in 1979. Today, it is considered a landmark but overlooked piece of television history thanks to its sympathetic portrayal of a homosexual relationship. In this special interview, Gilbert recalls his struggle to bring Only Connect to the screen, the challenges of making an openly gay drama for mainstream television and the impact the piece has had in the decades since its original broadcast.

programme.title: The Other Side
programme.desc: Young academic Graham visits the elderly John Bury to learn more about pioneering socialist and gay rights campaigner Edward Carpenter for his thesis on the early UK Labour movement. Graham wants the facts but discovers, to his advantage, that people are not text books.

programme.title: Remembers...
programme.desc: National treasure Alison Steadman tells the story of one of the most groundbreaking and yet also most overlooked moments in British television. Despite the popular perception that Channel 4’s Brookside broadcast TV’s first lesbian kiss in 1994, in reality it was Alison and Myra Frances who first broke the taboo 20 years earlier, in the 1974 drama Girl. Once thought lost forever, due to the fact that not every programme was archived back in those times, the drama later resurfaced, thanks to a random video recording – giving Alison the opportunity to share her memories of how she approached the moment and the reaction it received.

programme.title: Second City Firsts
programme.desc: 1970s drama. Just as she is about to leave the army, Jackie has an encounter with an old lover. Stars Alison Steadman in an early TV role.

programme.title: Vienna: Empire, Dynasty and Dream
programme.desc: Simon Sebag Montefiore tells the story of Vienna, triumphant after the Ottoman threat receded at the end of the 17th century. No longer an outpost defending the west from Islamic invaders, the imperial capital was to become the most glittering in the world. The Habsburg emperors transformed the city from a fortress into a great cultural capital. Vienna became a city that would define the arts; a magnet for musicians, including Mozart, Haydn and Beethoven.

programme.title: The Climate Question
programme.desc: A global programme that reflects the variety of takes on climate change, how best to understand it and the world's attempts to avert it, temper it or adapt to it. It is not about questioning whether climate change is happening, it's about finding the best ways to respond to it. This is sharp-edged, analytical inquiry. Hard scrutiny, touched with a sense of adventure and discovery, and where we can find it, hope. It includes stories from across the world on why we find it so hard to save our own planet, and how we might change that.

programme.title: Escape to the Country

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Lee Burkhill and Chris Hull are in Northampton to transform Jackie’s bland and inaccessible garden into a place where she can drink tea with her best mate Debbie. The garden needs to be wheelchair-friendly for Jackie, a relaxing place full of colour where she can potter to her heart's content. Charlie Dimmock and Flo Headlam visit Southampton to transform Sarah and Phill’s long-overgrown and unloved plot into a gothic-inspired garden. They would love a space full of dark, haunting plants and features, and a 'catio' for their two Siamese cats.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage of the opening match in Group K as Portugal face the Democratic Republic of Congo in Houston. Portugal come into the tournament ten years on from winning Euro 2016, and they are highly fancied to go deep into this World Cup. Head coach Roberto Martinez has a hugely talented group of players to choose from, including PSG midfielder Vitinha, 41-year-old Cristiano Ronaldo and Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes. The Democratic Republic of Congo featured at the 1974 edition – then known as Zaire – and return to the World Cup 52 years later following dramatic qualification in extra time of their intercontinental play-off against Jamaica. Their squad contains plenty of Premier League names, including West Ham defender Aaron Wan-Bissaka, Sunderland midfielder Noah Sadiki and Newcastle striker Yoane Wissa.

They would love a space full of dark, haunting plants and features, and a 'catio' for their two Siamese cats.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage of the opening match in Group K as Portugal face the Democratic Republic of Congo in Houston. Portugal come into the tournament ten years on from winning Euro 2016, and they are highly fancied to go deep into this World Cup. Head coach Roberto Martinez has a hugely talented group of players to choose from, including PSG midfielder Vitinha, 41-year-old Cristiano Ronaldo and Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes. The Democratic Republic of Congo featured at the 1974 edition – then known as Zaire – and return to the World Cup 52 years later following dramatic qualification in extra time of their intercontinental play-off against Jamaica. Their squad contains plenty of Premier League names, including West Ham defender Aaron Wan-Bissaka, Sunderland midfielder Noah Sadiki and Newcastle striker Yoane Wissa.

programme.title: Funboys
programme.desc: Life in Ballymacnoose becomes very complicated when Callum accidentally walks in on Gemma and Lorcan trying out a new form of lovemaking. The sight triggers a long-buried childhood trauma in Callum and raises uncomfortable questions about the town’s deeply repressed relationship with sex. Can Ballymacnoose open its heart to true love? Meanwhile, Jordan has officially begun dating his much older lover, 50-year-old Grainne. But as their relationship deepens, Jordan is confronted with another harsh reality of adulthood: he’s going bald. Faced with the slow retreat of his hairline and the love of a good woman, Jordan must decide whether to cling to denial or embrace manhood in all its forms - love, responsibility and mushroom carbonaras.

programme.title: Funboys
programme.desc: As Callum begins slowly unravelling under the strain of Jordan's relentless night terrors about baldness, he stumbles upon a flyer for Ballymacbot Wars - a local robot combat tournament offering a generous cash prize and potential ticket out of Jordan’s bedroom. Meanwhile, Jordan is uncharacteristically uninterested in the whole affair. He's become a bald hermit, terrified to leave the house and expose his creamy scalp to the outside world. That is, until, like a dagger in the night, a hooded burst of inspiration sends him back out into the world… and the robot wars.

programme.title: OnlyFans: Inside the Machine
programme.desc: Behind the billion-pound success of OnlyFans lies a hidden ecosystem of exploitation. A BBC Current Affairs investigation uncovers allegations of exploitation, coercion and violence committed by some of the hundreds of agents who manage many of the platform’s creators as well as the potential for modern slavery. Through survivor testimony, undercover access to a managers’ chat forum and expert legal analysis, the film exposes an industry where young women are trapped, threatened and profited from - raising urgent questions about accountability at the heart of one of Britain's most lucrative tech companies.

programme.title: Funboys
programme.desc: Life in Ballymacnoose becomes very complicated when Callum accidentally walks in on Gemma and Lorcan trying out a new form of lovemaking. The sight triggers a long-buried childhood trauma in Callum and raises uncomfortable questions about the town’s deeply repressed relationship with sex. Can Ballymacnoose open its heart to true love? Meanwhile, Jordan has officially begun dating his much older lover, 50-year-old Grainne. But as their relationship deepens, Jordan is confronted with another harsh reality of adulthood: he’s going bald. Faced with the slow retreat of his hairline and the love of a good woman, Jordan must decide whether to cling to denial or embrace manhood in all its forms - love, responsibility and mushroom carbonaras.

programme.title: Funboys
programme.desc: As Callum begins slowly unravelling under the strain of Jordan's relentless night terrors about baldness, he stumbles upon a flyer for Ballymacbot Wars - a local robot combat tournament offering a generous cash prize and potential ticket out of Jordan’s bedroom. Meanwhile, Jordan is uncharacteristically uninterested in the whole affair. He's become a bald hermit, terrified to leave the house and expose his creamy scalp to the outside world. That is, until, like a dagger in the night, a hooded burst of inspiration sends him back out into the world… and the robot wars.

programme.title: OnlyFans: Inside the Machine
programme.desc: Behind the billion-pound success of OnlyFans lies a hidden ecosystem of exploitation. A BBC Current Affairs investigation uncovers allegations of exploitation, coercion and violence committed by some of the hundreds of agents who manage many of the platform’s creators as well as the potential for modern slavery. Through survivor testimony, undercover access to a managers’ chat forum and expert legal analysis, the film exposes an industry where young women are trapped, threatened and profited from - raising urgent questions about accountability at the heart of one of Britain's most lucrative tech companies.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage of the opening match in Group K as Portugal face the Democratic Republic of Congo in Houston. Portugal come into the tournament ten years on from winning Euro 2016, and they are highly fancied to go deep into this World Cup. Head coach Roberto Martinez has a hugely talented group of players to choose from, including PSG midfielder Vitinha, 41-year-old Cristiano Ronaldo and Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes. The Democratic Republic of Congo featured at the 1974 edition – then known as Zaire – and return to the World Cup 52 years later following dramatic qualification in extra time of their intercontinental play-off against Jamaica. The garden needs to be wheelchair-friendly for Jackie, a relaxing place full of colour where she can potter to her heart's content. Charlie Dimmock and Flo Headlam visit Southampton to transform Sarah and Phill’s long-overgrown and unloved plot into a gothic-inspired garden. They would love a space full of dark, haunting plants and features, and a 'catio' for their two Siamese cats.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage of the opening match in Group K as Portugal face the Democratic Republic of Congo in Houston. Portugal come into the tournament ten years on from winning Euro 2016, and they are highly fancied to go deep into this World Cup. Head coach Roberto Martinez has a hugely talented group of players to choose from, including PSG midfielder Vitinha, 41-year-old Cristiano Ronaldo and Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes. The Democratic Republic of Congo featured at the 1974 edition – then known as Zaire – and return to the World Cup 52 years later following dramatic qualification in extra time of their intercontinental play-off against Jamaica. Their squad contains plenty of Premier League names, including West Ham defender Aaron Wan-Bissaka, Sunderland midfielder Noah Sadiki and Newcastle striker Yoane Wissa.

programme.title: Reporting Scotland
programme.desc: More from the day’s top stories and communities across Scotland.

programme.title: Food Fest Scotland
programme.desc: Edith Bowman and Colin Murray explore the Glasgow Foodies’ Festival, where they discover the secrets to the best egg fried rice with chef Jimmy Lee, and how to spot ‘fake’ vanilla. Chef Julie Lin digs deep to reveal some myths about frozen food. Farmer Jim Smith learns the art of pickling, and discovers how and why one farm is turning its oats into milk.

programme.title: Born to Be Wild
programme.desc: The acting head of large mammals, April, has a problem – the team have admitted a tiny badger cub, but she is completely alone. April sets about handrearing the little orphan, which she names Miss Honey, but badgers are social animals and the cub needs a friend. It’s a few weeks before Miss Honey is joined by two other orphans – the similarly Roald Dahl-themed Bruce and Matilda. The trio happily adapt to the centre’s custom-made artificial sett before they are returned to the wild. Meanwhile, centre vet and keen birder Liam has a real challenge on his hand - an injured common sandpiper has been brought in after being being caught by a cat. With an eye injury, it’s a real case of touch-and-go as to whether the little sandpiper will survive. However, aided by the exceptional skills of Liam, the wader recovers and the vet is able to return it to the wild with the help of his family.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of Michelle Mone
programme.desc: The extraordinary story of a young girl who grew up poor in Glasgow’s East End and went on to live a life filled with private jets, mega yachts and opulent homes around the world. But the price of these luxuries turned out to be much more than the money they cost. Baroness Michelle Mone achieved everything she had ever dreamed of - fame, power, money and status. Yet just when she thought she had made it in life, it all came tumbling down.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of Michelle Mone
programme.desc: The story of Michelle Mone’s elevation to the House of Lords and the ongoing controversy around her links to a business which was awarded a PPE contract through the so-called ‘VIP lane’.

programme.desc: Jules and Greg kick off in the crystal-clear waters of St Abbs, snorkelling the south east coast, before taking on the waves at Coldingham Bay.

programme.title: This is BBC Scotland
programme.desc: Highlights from the BBC Scotland channel.

programme.title: Disclosure
programme.desc: Around one in seven people in the UK are on antidepressants, but do we know all we need to about the risks and benefits of taking this medication? Anton Ferrie investigates the impact of these pills on the minds and bodies of the thousands of young people who take them and meets those for whom their use has had profound consequences. Some say these drugs have saved their lives; others that they’ve changed them permanently, wiping out their sex lives and numbing them to the world around them.

programme.title: BBC Comedy Short Films
programme.desc: Single, penniless poet Ruby has recently moved back home to live with her mum, Jen. When their strict Presbyterian neighbours descend on the home for her spoiled sister Eliza's engagement party, Ruby’s only job is to not shame the family...

programme.title: Walking With Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Sixty-six million years ago, an orphaned baby triceratops roamed the lush world of Laramidia, alone and vulnerable. Stalked by the fearsome Tyrannosaurus rex, the youngster relied on her wits and diminutive size to survive. Today, paleontologists in Montana are uncovering her fossils, allowing us to imagine her life and the dangers she faced. Stunning VFX recreate her encounters, from escaping a giant pterosaur to a heart-stopping face-off with T. rex, bringing her story vividly to life.

programme.title: Walking With Dinosaurs
programme.desc: North Africa, 100 million years ago. A Spinosaurus father must embark on a dangerous voyage to feed his babies. To reach the destination, he must lead his young family across one of the deadliest environments in earth’s history: a land crawling with ferocious predators. At the end of their journey, an extraordinary feast awaits - if he can run the gauntlet without his babies becoming someone else’s meal.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: The ruined temples of Sri Lanka are home to Gremlin, a baby toque macaque. With predators nearby and a rivalry with other monkeys brewing, she must quickly learn how to survive.

programme.title: Walking With Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Utah, 130 million years ago. A band of armoured dinosaurs battle to reach adulthood, pursued by some of the most formidable predators that have ever lived: utahraptors. It’s a deadly game of cat and mouse that pits heavy armour against vicious claws and lethal cunning; a life-and-death struggle that builds to a final showdown amongst the flames of a burning forest.

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May test the Aston Martin Rapide, the Porsche Panamera Turbo and the Maserati Quattroporte as they attempt to find the world's greatest four-seat supercar. After an early morning start in the City of London, the boys embark on a road trip across the south of England, stop off for a race around a closed-off business park, and end up undertaking a rather special chauffeuring job. Meanwhile, Richard is on the test track in two very different muscle cars, the Chevrolet Camaro SS and Mercedes E63 AMG. And there's a double dose of celebrity as Harry Potter star Rupert Grint and F1 ace Rubens Barrichello take their turns as the Stars in a Reasonably Priced Car.

programme.title: Children of Men
programme.desc: 2027. In a chaotic future, children are no longer being born because of a years-long fertility crisis. Borders are closed, and Britain has become a brutal police state, with immigrants herded into cages and treated like animals. Government employee Theo receives a message from someone from his past, asking for help getting a refugee some papers. But Theo is soon drawn into something much bigger than himself. Kee is not just a refugee needing help - she is pregnant.

programme.title: Thailand: The Dark Side of Paradise
programme.desc: After being invited to a bar crawl on Khaosan Road, Zara gets under the skin of Bangkok’s notorious red light district, Soi Cowboy - but filming is swiftly shut down by local bar owners and the police. When Zara meets Mike Yu, a young British expat living a life of luxury in the Thai capital, she realises there is more to the city than meets the eye. Meanwhile, a visit to the Bangkok Immigration Detention Centre exposes how easy it is to get caught on the wrong side of the law in Thailand.

programme.title: Thailand: The Dark Side of Paradise
programme.desc: As she explores more of Thailand, Zara visits Pattaya, where she meets Mac, a British YouTuber lifting the lid on Asia’s sex capital. However, Annie, a local sex worker, reveals the harsh reality of working in the illegal sex industry. After journeying to the island of Ko Phangan, Zara finds her paradise: beautiful beaches and tranquil temples, but Lucio, a Brit who built a burgeoning cannabis business here whilst the drug was decriminalised, reveals that navigating the local law isn’t always easy. Hugo shares his shocking near-death experience that exposes how the island plays by its own rules.

programme.title: Thailand: The Dark Side of Paradise
programme.desc: Zara experiences Ko Phangan’s world-famous Full Moon Party, but beneath the cheap cocktails, music and fire shows, there is danger lurking as the medical team treat a possible drink-spiking victim. Finally, Zara journeys to Phuket, where she meets Dave, an expat who shows off the island’s high-end beach clubs. She also meets Shakira, a tourist in trouble with the Thai police who reveals how easily dream holidays can go wrong. Zara then discovers the tragic case of a British holidaymaker who recently lost their life on the island and whose family is still searching for answers. A final catch-up with backpacker Loukas exposes the true price of letting loose in Thailand.

programme.title: Springwatch
programme.desc: Chris Packham and Michaela Strachan present the latest seasonal wildlife stories live from National Trust Crom, the stunning lakeside reserve cared for by the National Trust. Featuring part one of a special trilogy of short films examining the extraordinary relationship between the reed warbler and the common cuckoo, one of nature’s most fascinating examples of brood parasitism. Meanwhile, Iolo Williams broadcasts live from the Natural History Museum in London, where he turns the spotlight on the capital’s rich and often-overlooked invertebrate life.

programme.title: Surgeons: At the Edge of Life
programme.desc: A surgeon has one chance to tackle a life-threatening tumour in his patient’s liver and diaphragm. A neurosurgeon must save her patient from paralysis with unerring precision.

programme.title: Interior Design Masters with Alan Carr
programme.desc: The two finalists head to Longleat Estate to transform rental cottages, taking inspiration from either the nearby safari park or from the surrounding countryside. They aim to show judges Michelle Ogundehin and Laurence Llewelyn-Bowen how much their design ability has evolved during the competition before one of them wins Interior Design Masters and a partnership with retailer Next for their own homewares range.

programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Breakfast
programme.desc: The latest news, sport, business and weather from the BBC's Breakfast team.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Charlie Dimmock heads back to Devizes to revisit one of the gardens she created with Chris Hull. John and Vanessa had wanted an Oman-inspired outdoor space perfect for entertaining, and four years on, Charlie is delighted to find a garden bursting with life and vibrant colour, with the firepit and social area still at the heart of it all. Charlie also reconnects with Lisa in Bedhampton, whose dream of a Greek-style garden inspired by holidays to Kos and the Greek Islands blossomed into something even better. Finally, Charlie catches up with Luke, who wanted a Japanese garden that would also be a fun, safe space for his young son Jude and discovers how the design has matured into a tranquil, family-friendly haven.

programme.title: Great Japanese Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael begins a journey in and around Kyushu, the southernmost of Japan’s four main islands, and southern Honshu. He begins his exploration in Kagoshima, an extraordinary city which sits in the shadow of Japan’s most active volcano, Sakurajima. In the Sakurajima International Volcano Centre, Michael discovers how scientists use the latest technology to predict and warn of future volcano eruptions. He rides one of Japan’s quirky themed express trains to Ibusuki, a coastal town where he goes sand bathing. Inland is Chiran, the site of a former World War II airbase and now the Chiran Peace Museum. Michael learns of 439 young pilots who flew from Chiran to their deaths in the notorious kamikaze missions of the Pacific War.

programme.title: Great Central Asian Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo embarks on a thrilling railway adventure following the Silk Road through the most populous country of Central Asia, Uzbekistan. At the meeting point of east and west, this region has been home to some of the world’s greatest empires: ruled by the Mongols, the ferocious conqueror Tamerlane, imperial Russia and the Soviet Union. Michael begins in the capital, Tashkent, where he takes in its vast, vibrant market and samples popular Uzbek delicacies. He travels on the lavishly decorated Soviet-era metro, which was hidden from the outside world until 2018, when a ban on photographing it was lifted. Michael hears how an earthquake resulted in Tashkent becoming the capital of Soviet modernist architecture, and he makes his TikTok debut with a globally famous Uzbek social media star.

programme.desc: The big political issues of the day.

programme.title: Queen's Tennis
programme.desc: Live coverage from day 10 of the 2026 Queen's tennis tournament.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Ben Bailey Smith, Robin Ince, Lara Ricote and Helen Skelton take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted with the very popular bee hotel?

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo’s saga through Norway and Denmark resumes in Larvik on Norway’s southern coast, where he investigates the city’s prized natural resource, a distinctive blue rock named larvikite. From Larvik’s port, he boards a ferry for Denmark, landing in Hirtshals. At the tip of the Jutland Peninsula, Michael visits the 19th-century artists’ colony of Skagen to admire their light-filled landscapes. He then heads south to the pastures of Holstebro, home to some of Denmark’s half a million cows. Denmark produces 85 million kilos of butter and five billion kilos of milk per year. Michael visits the Lurpak factory to see one of the nation’s premier industries.

programme.title: Unspun World with John Simpson
programme.desc: Unspun World provides an unvarnished version of the week's major global news stories - reliable, honest and essential viewing. The BBC's world affairs editor, John Simpson, brings his experience and expertise to bear on the most important international stories. In discussion with the BBC's unparalleled range of experts across the world, he uses their unique local knowledge to go beyond the headlines to get to the unspun truth about the world.

programme.title: In Ten Pictures
programme.desc: Britney Spears was one of the biggest pop stars of her generation. She grew up in the limelight, and like so many music stars, she was defined by imagery. But she was also the subject of extraordinary exploitation and control. Years of personal and professional turmoil would play out in the frenzied glare of the media spotlight: breakups, breakdowns and familial fall outs. From the over-sexualisation of a child performer to the very public struggles with her mental health, this is the story of a manufactured child star fighting for control over her music, her life and her image.

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: From coffee-making robots in Japan to bionic limbs in New York, can revolutionary technology transform the lives of millions of disabled people?

programme.title: Do You Know Your Place?
programme.desc: Vernon Kay hosts the final day of the week’s whistlestop tour of the UK. EastEnders star Nitin Ganatra, the Rev Kate Bottley and Alex Gray, aka Apollo from Gladiators, are this week’s players, and this is their final chance to claim glory. As ever, Paul Gorton is the unreliable tour guide, and he’s taking the players to Wrexham.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Charlie Dimmock heads back to Devizes to revisit one of the gardens she created with Chris Hull. John and Vanessa had wanted an Oman-inspired outdoor space perfect for entertaining, and four years on, Charlie is delighted to find a garden bursting with life and vibrant colour, with the firepit and social area still at the heart of it all. Charlie also reconnects with Lisa in Bedhampton, whose dream of a Greek-style garden inspired by holidays to Kos and the Greek Islands blossomed into something even better. Finally, Charlie catches up with Luke, who wanted a Japanese garden that would also be a fun, safe space for his young son Jude and discovers how the design has matured into a tranquil, family-friendly haven.

programme.title: Great Japanese Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael begins a journey in and around Kyushu, the southernmost of Japan’s four main islands, and southern Honshu. He begins his exploration in Kagoshima, an extraordinary city which sits in the shadow of Japan’s most active volcano, Sakurajima. In the Sakurajima International Volcano Centre, Michael discovers how scientists use the latest technology to predict and warn of future volcano eruptions. He rides one of Japan’s quirky themed express trains to Ibusuki, a coastal town where he goes sand bathing. Inland is Chiran, the site of a former World War II airbase and now the Chiran Peace Museum. Michael learns of 439 young pilots who flew from Chiran to their deaths in the notorious kamikaze missions of the Pacific War.

programme.title: Great Central Asian Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo embarks on a thrilling railway adventure following the Silk Road through the most populous country of Central Asia, Uzbekistan. At the meeting point of east and west, this region has been home to some of the world’s greatest empires: ruled by the Mongols, the ferocious conqueror Tamerlane, imperial Russia and the Soviet Union. Michael begins in the capital, Tashkent, where he takes in its vast, vibrant market and samples popular Uzbek delicacies. He travels on the lavishly decorated Soviet-era metro, which was hidden from the outside world until 2018, when a ban on photographing it was lifted. Michael hears how an earthquake resulted in Tashkent becoming the capital of Soviet modernist architecture, and he makes his TikTok debut with a globally famous Uzbek social media star.

programme.title: One Zoo Three
programme.desc: The One Zoo Three brothers explore San Diego Zoo Safari Park in the US and come face to face with rhinos, giraffes and the California condor. Tyler is faced with one of the biggest piles of poo he he has ever seen while on the trail of a crash of white rhinos. But this is no ordinary mountain of muck – Tyler discovers the importance of a rhino loo and what these animals can do with a pile of poo! Meanwhile, Aaron is lucky enough to go behind the scenes at the safari park’s special lab, where he discovers how the latest science is being used to bring back certain species, such as the beautiful Przewalski’s horse, from the brink of extinction, . Cam has a unique opportunity to look at a California condor chick inside an egg and to hand-feed a young lappet-faced vulture, with the help of an unusual puppet. Cute Alert introduces an adorable little beauty who lives up high in the branches – Som, the Matschie’s tree-kangaroo. And Aaron sticks his neck out to reveal some real wows and wonders about the giraffe –- but are they fact or fake?

The Squirrels embark on their own individual discoveries outside in rivers, the sea, mountains, the jungle and the desert. They learn how to spot an animal’s disguise, better known as its camouflage. programme.desc: Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Reau, Alfie, Charlie, Ollie, Otis, River and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their little ones at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! Inside Giovanna’s bag is a night light, and all the parents and babies have different objects and toys that could be used as part of a bedtime routine. These are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding safe, baby-appropriate bedtime objects and toys inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The baby lullaby Little One Time For Bed features, as does a story involving Baby Bear, and viewers at home show what they’ve been doing at bedtime too. The Baby Bear Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with sensory lights and the Goodbye Song.

The Squirrels have all sorts of questions to ask.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: The Colourblocks meet a new animal - but what colour is it? Learn about a creature that can change colour with the Colourblocks.

programme.desc: Holly wants to know all there is to know about wriggly earthworms! Ferne visits a worm farm and meets worm expert Ken, and they handle different species of UK worms. Meanwhile, Rory and his son Sandy search the compost bin and the garden for worms and decide to build a wormery to make worm tea! Also, we find out why earthworms are so important to the planet by being amazing soil engineers.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Iona and Elba make pancakes for a fabulous family breakfast. There’s lots of egg cracking, whisking, and fruit chopping, but will Iona manage a successful pancake flip? Later, the sisters build a car for their teddy bear - beep beep! And Iona draws a family tree with Mum and learns all about her relatives, old and new.

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Eddie's mum is Italian and has taught him how to make a traditional Italian pizza. Eddie makes a delicious cheese and olive pizza using homemade dough and a tasty tomato sauce. His friends are in for a real treat when they see that Eddie's mum cooks the pizza in their traditional pizza oven. He tops his pizza with black olives, but some of Eddie's friends aren't too sure about olives when they taste them on their own. Eddie hopes to change their minds when they try them on his pizza. He even teaches them a little bit of Italian to really get them into the spirit of things.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: In this episode, Maddie finds out what happens when we have our picture taken. She shows us how the parts of a camera work to make the image bright and clear. With the help of a pinhole camera, Maddie learns what happens when light goes into the lens in order to take a picture. Next, Maddie heads to a hairbrush factory. We see how a hairbrush is made from big planks of wood. She uses her special cameras to see the robots turn the wood into a rounded brush handle shape at very fast speeds. We also see machines that drill hundreds of holes into the wood to punch the bristles in.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Newfoundland Sylvie is a big therapy dog with big soft cuddles who loves to help people when they’re worried. She and her owner Katrina visit all sorts of people every day, young and old. Sylvie and Katrina are visiting some schoolchildren on their very first day at school. Sylvie knows the children will be feeling nervous and excited all at once. She helps the children find the classroom with a big blue pencil on its door, and then she and Katrina help the children do a relay race around an obstacle course in the school hall. The children are nervous, so Sylvie offers to go first. But when one little girl, Navinda, is scared of 'the big bear', Sylvie has to use her superheart to be be calmer and friendlier than ever before.

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet the longest venomous snake in the world, the king cobra. They are some of the best snake mums, as they are one of the few snakes that make nests for their eggs. Next, they meet an animal that has no brain, heart or bones - the sea nettle jellyfish. These two animals are very different, but Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the unusual and extraordinary wild connection is between them.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Flynne helps Oona find Mossy, and proves she can be a friendly fox.

programme.title: Small Potatoes

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: When a touring musical pigeon lands in the garden, the poor bird finds he has lost his flying beat. Yukee and the garden gang help Feathers find the right wing-flapping beat to get back in the air.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: It’s bath time in Higgledy-Piggledy, but Triggs can’t find his bath toy, Denis the Ducky. They embark on a bubble-tastic submarine adventure to the bottom of the ocean, but can Captain Maddie and Lieutenant Triggs rescue Denis the Ducky before it’s too late?

programme.title: Hey Duggee

They find out that wisdom isn’t just about facts and figures, but that it's about good judgement and experiences too. They learn to plan ahead, concentrate on the task at hand, that sometimes big problems need a little help, to focus on the present and that good things come to those who wait. Thank goodness Duggee is so wise!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: One of the bottles in Ten's collection accidentally falls off the wall, setting off a spectacular numbery hullabaloo. Learn to count down from ten by taking one away with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. From A to Z, every Alphablock has fun discovering the magic of wordplay. D is ready to rock - he has his drumsticks but nothing to bang on. With a little help from his friends, he tries a pan and a pin. But how can he deliver his dazzling drum solo? This episode introduces the letter D and the words sat, pad, pan, pin, tap and din.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Ben meets Leith at a farm to see the different animals that live there, including donkeys, pigs and chickens. Mr Tumble is at the farm too, and he's trying to keep his brand new wellies clean. There's an animal guessing game in the spotty surprise. Featuring the signs for farm, muddy and chicken.

programme.title: Teletubbies

programme.title: Andy's Dinosaur Adventures
programme.desc: Andy travels back 127 million years to the time of the iguanodon, a plant-eating dinosaur that moved in herds. His mission is to find the herd and make a plaster copy of one of its footprints to replace the one he accidentally broke back at the museum. He watches with amazement how they stand on their hind legs to reach the leaves of tall trees, before taking a stroll on a beach with a huge herd of them. But will he succeed in time before the museum opens?

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack’s Stall. She chooses the photo of Bob and Ted and remembers the day she got it. When Bob’s identical twin, Ted, arrives at the Big Hub for a visit, Molly and Mack can’t believe how alike they are. Bob and Ted tell them how they used to pretend to be one another when they were boys. This gives Molly an idea! Bob and Ted could play the same trick again, on everyone in the Hub. programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: After watching the birds fly above them, the Squirrels discover that birds can also slide, run and lay eggs. This encourages them to learn more about the natural environment, and they discover how to do this responsibly with Duggee’s five easy steps: watch carefully, stay at a distance, don’t interfere, be patient and alert, and stay quiet. The Squirrels embark on their own individual discoveries outside in rivers, the sea, mountains, the jungle and the desert. They learn how to spot an animal’s disguise, better known as its camouflage. They see how birds may try to impress one another, which is in stark contrast to how a horned lizard uses its body to warn other creatures off. A fascinating look at nature!

programme.title: My Petsaurus

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po watch bunny rabbits. Bunny ears and tails appear on the Teletubbies. They do the bunny hop hop before saying 'eh oh' to the Tiddlytubbies.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Reau, Alfie, Charlie, Ollie, Otis, River and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their little ones at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! Inside Giovanna’s bag is a night light, and all the parents and babies have different objects and toys that could be used as part of a bedtime routine. These are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding safe, baby-appropriate bedtime objects and toys inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The baby lullaby Little One Time For Bed features, as does a story involving Baby Bear, and viewers at home show what they’ve been doing at bedtime too. The Baby Bear Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with sensory lights and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: In Tall Trees Forest, Lisa and the children weave trees from wool on paper plates, learn signs for wool, bags and lane, and sing and sign Baa Baa Black Sheep.

programme.title: What’s in Your Plant Pot?
programme.desc: Henna artist Pavan introduces the Fact Pack to her henna plant. They learn how henna leaves are turned into a natural dye, how mehndi patterns are created, and why henna is used for celebrations around the world.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Bean the warthog is impatient for his for breakfast. Hamza travels into the wild and discovers some birds called crown cranes. He also helps protects the rhinos’ skin from the hot sun.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger aids a teething baby Cuke with an incessant sucking habit to get back to its herd.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: It's bedtime, and Bingo can't remember where she left her beloved Floppy. Retracing their steps, Bingo and Bluey lead their Mum through their bizarre day in the hope of tracking Floppy down.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: It’s news time at the Clubhouse, and the Squirrels share their exciting news of the week with each other. Happy got a new bath sponge, Norrie is growing a sunflower and Roly, after thinking hard if he’s got any news at all, remembers he’s getting a new brother or sister. The Squirrels have all sorts of questions to ask.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: The Colourblocks meet a new animal - but what colour is it? Learn about a creature that can change colour with the Colourblocks.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Holly wants to know all there is to know about wriggly earthworms! Ferne visits a worm farm and meets worm expert Ken, and they handle different species of UK worms. Meanwhile, Rory and his son Sandy search the compost bin and the garden for worms and decide to build a wormery to make worm tea! Also, we find out why earthworms are so important to the planet by being amazing soil engineers.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Iona and Elba make pancakes for a fabulous family breakfast. There’s lots of egg cracking, whisking, and fruit chopping, but will Iona manage a successful pancake flip? Later, the sisters build a car for their teddy bear - beep beep! And Iona draws a family tree with Mum and learns all about her relatives, old and new.

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Eddie's mum is Italian and has taught him how to make a traditional Italian pizza. Eddie makes a delicious cheese and olive pizza using homemade dough and a tasty tomato sauce. His friends are in for a real treat when they see that Eddie's mum cooks the pizza in their traditional pizza oven. He tops his pizza with black olives, but some of Eddie's friends aren't too sure about olives when they taste them on their own. Eddie hopes to change their minds when they try them on his pizza. He even teaches them a little bit of Italian to really get them into the spirit of things.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: In this episode, Maddie finds out what happens when we have our picture taken. She shows us how the parts of a camera work to make the image bright and clear. With the help of a pinhole camera, Maddie learns what happens when light goes into the lens in order to take a picture. Next, Maddie heads to a hairbrush factory. We see how a hairbrush is made from big planks of wood. She uses her special cameras to see the robots turn the wood into a rounded brush handle shape at very fast speeds. We also see machines that drill hundreds of holes into the wood to punch the bristles in.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Newfoundland Sylvie is a big therapy dog with big soft cuddles who loves to help people when they’re worried. She and her owner Katrina visit all sorts of people every day, young and old. Sylvie and Katrina are visiting some schoolchildren on their very first day at school. Sylvie knows the children will be feeling nervous and excited all at once. She helps the children find the classroom with a big blue pencil on its door, and then she and Katrina help the children do a relay race around an obstacle course in the school hall. The children are nervous, so Sylvie offers to go first. But when one little girl, Navinda, is scared of 'the big bear', Sylvie has to use her superheart to be be calmer and friendlier than ever before.

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet the longest venomous snake in the world, the king cobra. They are some of the best snake mums, as they are one of the few snakes that make nests for their eggs. Next, they meet an animal that has no brain, heart or bones - the sea nettle jellyfish. These two animals are very different, but Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the unusual and extraordinary wild connection is between them.

programme.desc: Flynne helps Oona find Mossy, and proves she can be a friendly fox.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: When a touring musical pigeon lands in the garden, the poor bird finds he has lost his flying beat. Yukee and the garden gang help Feathers find the right wing-flapping beat to get back in the air.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: It’s bath time in Higgledy-Piggledy, but Triggs can’t find his bath toy, Denis the Ducky. They embark on a bubble-tastic submarine adventure to the bottom of the ocean, but can Captain Maddie and Lieutenant Triggs rescue Denis the Ducky before it’s too late?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels see Duggee reading Wonderful Stories about Wise Animals and want to learn about wisdom and how they can become wiser. They find out that wisdom isn’t just about facts and figures, but that it's about good judgement and experiences too. They learn to plan ahead, concentrate on the task at hand, that sometimes big problems need a little help, to focus on the present and that good things come to those who wait. Thank goodness Duggee is so wise!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: One of the bottles in Ten's collection accidentally falls off the wall, setting off a spectacular numbery hullabaloo. Learn to count down from ten by taking one away with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. From A to Z, every Alphablock has fun discovering the magic of wordplay. D is ready to rock - he has his drumsticks but nothing to bang on. With a little help from his friends, he tries a pan and a pin. But how can he deliver his dazzling drum solo? This episode introduces the letter D and the words sat, pad, pan, pin, tap and din.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Ben meets Leith at a farm to see the different animals that live there, including donkeys, pigs and chickens. programme.title: Andy's Dinosaur Adventures
programme.desc: Andy travels back 127 million years to the time of the iguanodon, a plant-eating dinosaur that moved in herds. His mission is to find the herd and make a plaster copy of one of its footprints to replace the one he accidentally broke back at the museum. He watches with amazement how they stand on their hind legs to reach the leaves of tall trees, before taking a stroll on a beach with a huge herd of them. But will he succeed in time before the museum opens?

programme.title: American Dad!
programme.desc: Animated series about CIA agent Stan Smith. Because of a past incident at his own prom, where he was lured into a dance with the homecoming queen only to have a pile of pigs dropped on him, Stan wants revenge by showing off that he married a homecoming queen, Francine. A proud Stan accompanies Francine to her reunion, but when they find out that two ballots were lost and that Francine didn't actually win the crown, Stan is devastated.

programme.title: Bob's Burgers
programme.desc: Animated comedy about Bob Belcher, who runs Bob's Burgers restaurant, and his family. When Gene's decision to spend all his savings on trying a new VR gaming arcade comes with disappointment as the games are horrible and refunds are not on the agenda, Bob journeys into cyberspace with his son to help him cope with the letdown - meanwhile, Louise and Tina build a towering house of cards out of store menus, but fear of completion becomes a problem as the structure nears the diner ceiling.

programme.title: Bob's Burgers
programme.desc: Animated comedy about Bob Belcher, who runs Bob's Burgers restaurant, and his family. When Louise can't decide what to pick for her preferred future job for a Career Day, her family suggest ideas in a series of exciting and wacky stories.

programme.title: Plebs
programme.desc: The first episode of a sitcom following three desperate young men who reside in ancient Rome. programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Home improvement programme where contractor Brian McCourt and designer Sarah Keenleyside help to expand living spaces by tapping into people's backyards. Jet setters Sonia and Peter have resorted to staycations at home since having two young children, but their backyard is more of a headache than a holiday - Brian and Sarah therefore create a luxury vacation destination in their backyard that includes a pool, a spa, an outdoor kitchen and a stunning four-season structure.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: Stephen Mulhern is back with the exciting and iconic gameshow as another brave contestant takes on the infamous Banker and, by opening those iconic 22 red boxes in the right order, could be in with the chance of winning a life-changing cash prize. There are no questions here except for one: Deal or No Deal?

programme.title: Dress To Impress
programme.desc: Londoner Frankie is hoping to find her dream man. Which of the three single men shopping for her will impress her enough to win a date?

programme.title: Billie & Greg: The Family Diaries
programme.desc: Reality series. As the novelty of the chore chart wears off, Billie and Greg continue to address the kids' behaviour and debate whether to get Nelly the phone she so desperately wants with her birthday approaching - elsewhere, the family take a trip to a history museum in an attempt to show them just how lucky they are, and after turning up to Sue's house drunk, Billie and her mum decide that it's time to have an emotional heart-to-heart with Chatty.

programme.title: The Only Way is Essex
programme.desc: Pete and Chloe Sims have had more awkward chats than they've had hot dinners, but they are still no closer to getting their friendship back on track - the former self-proclaimed soulmates have reached a stalemate and it's time for a third-party intervention. Pete has enlisted a therapist to help the pair navigate their issues - when all three sit down for a serious heart-to-heart, will bridges be built and will Pete and Chloe acknowledge that their feelings for one another may run deeper than they've been letting on when some shocking secrets come to light? Elsewhere, Dan and Amber have been unshakeable recently, but a spanner's been thrown in the works - it turns out that Dan confided in Demi that their relationship wasn't all rosy during lockdown... and the information is winging its way back to Amber fast. How will she react when she finds out her significant other has been voicing concerns about their relationship to none other than a Sims, and will she be able to move on?

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City
programme.desc: US reality series peeking inside the unconventional lives of six successful women living in or around Salt Lake City, Utah. The second part of the fourth series reunion sees Monica break down while reflecting on her relationship with her mother and the rift between Angie and Monica grows as they disagree about the unseen events from Greek Easter - the group is then joined by Mary as she comes to Monica's defence and sheds light on where she currently stands with the rest of the women.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Orange County
programme.desc: Welcome to the Freak Show: Reality show. Heather finds herself isolated after the trip to Mexico and sets out to prove that Tamra is the cause of everyone's issues. [S] S17 Ep16

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Cheshire
programme.desc: Reality series. Ampika hosts a lavish charity event and instructs the ladies to be on their best behaviour - with Lystra still reeling, Rachel exasperated, and Paige determined to get answers, the masks are slipping from the start.

programme.title: Celebrity Catchphrase
programme.desc: Stephen Mulhern hosts a celebrity special of the classic game show with Vick Hope, Ranvir Singh and Iain Stirling all trying to 'say what they see' as they guess well-known phrases for the chance to win a 50,000-pound jackpot for their chosen charity.

programme.title: The Floor US

programme.title: The Only Way is Essex
programme.desc: Pete and Chloe Sims drop a major bombshell in a therapy session when they admit that the lines have been blurred when it comes to their friendship - the advice they received was straightforward, take some time apart or lose the friendship, and both parties are determined to stick to it... but how will each of them cope without the other when push comes to shove, does absence really make the heart grow fonder, or is it a case of out of sight, out of mind for good?
